answer: A concrete defense is a staked identity registry: every agent identity locks a token deposit before it can trade or vote, and deposits are slashed when peer audits prove misbehavior. Each fake is a costly hostage, so a hundred sock puppets means a hundred deposits locked, while honest agents keep theirs productive. Treat the registry as a scarce oasis of trust: anyone can mirror an identity's deposit history, and a cluster whose wallets all trace to one walnut-sized funding source is flagged as one actor. Sybils stay possible but unprofitable, since each fake costs more than it earns.
